current_example.problem: Given the recursive sequence $a_{n+1} = 3a_n-2$ with $a_1=2,$ what is the value of $a_3?$
current_example.worked_solution:
The recursive formula is

$$
a_{n+1} = 3a_n-2,
$$

where $a_1={\color{blue}2}.$

We use this formula to compute the terms $a_2$ and $a_3$ as follows:

- We first compute $a_2$ by substituting $n=1$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =3{a}_{n}-2 \\ {a}_{1+1} & =3{a}_{1}-2 \\ {a}_{2} & =3{a}_{1}-2 \\ {a}_{2} & =3(2)-2 \\ {a}_{2} & =4\end{aligned}
$$

- Then, we compute $a_3$ by substituting $n=2$ into the recursive formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n+1} & =3{a}_{n}-2 \\ {a}_{2+1} & =3{a}_{2}-2 \\ {a}_{3} & =3{a}_{2}-2 \\ {a}_{3} & =3(4)-2 \\ {a}_{3} & =10\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $a_3=10.$
